correctness.rationale: For the Cayley graph F_n on F₂^(n-1) generated by coordinate flips plus the antipodal flip, parity of the latter proves d(x,y)=min(h,n-h). Walsh characters diagonalize powered distance matrices with eigenvalues exact signed Krawtchouk sums by Hamming shells. The source includes all weights and multiplicities; independent character-sum evaluation at each candidate root confirmed the only vanishing sectors: F6 weights 3,4 (15 independent), F7 weights 3,4 (35), F8 parity weight 7 (1). The global sign argument bounds every other nontrivial weight eigenvalue strictly below zero up to the unique first root of 2*3^p-2^p-2, 3*3^p-3*2^p-1 and 35*4^p-56*3^p+28*2^p-8 respectively; the winner is increasing and remains positive beyond threshold. Schoenberg centered Gram rank gives exactly 16,28,126 dimensions at critical powers, 31,63,127 below. Independent numerical Walsh eigenvalue checks on 32,64,128 vertices corroborate all nontrivial signs and nullities, without replacing the analytic bounds.
